description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of tokens across several categories within the SALT dataset. The horizontal axis depicts “Categories” with labels including “Administrative,” “Religion,” “Non-fiction,” “Fiction,” “Law,” “News,” “Science,” and “Blogs,” arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis is labeled “Tokens (K)” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10,000, with tick marks placed at 2,000-unit intervals. Each category is represented by a light blue bar with a numerical value indicating the token count positioned above it; the “Administrative” category has a bar reaching 6472, “Religion” reaches 652, “Non-fiction” reaches 1889, “Fiction” reaches 387, “Law” reaches 354, “News” reaches 10584, “Science” reaches 1626, and “Blogs” reaches 32. No bars are visually emphasized, and the values above each bar appear to serve as direct labels for the bar height.
